demo_select: SELECT * FROM ESP_SOAP_LOG WHERE STATUS = :status ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT :top
demo_insert: INSERT INTO ESP_SOAP_LOG (NAME, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (:name, :status, SYSDATE)
demo_update: UPDATE ESP_SOAP_LOG SET STATUS = :status WHERE ID = :id
material_tag_print_query: SELECT Id,TagNo,RawMaterialId,MaterialCode,SkuName,Brand,Spec,Material,Count,Unit,BatchNo,Supplier,WarehouseCode,LocationCode,ReceiveDate,PrintStatus FROM MAT_MATERIAL_TAG WHERE TAGNO LIKE :TagNo
